integrity: The exponent comparison is exact and independently replayable. Deep source theorems are cited as literature premises, and the distinction between statement comparison and proof validation is explicit.
scientific_limitations: This finding compares public theorem statements and exact exponents; it does not independently re-prove Kaneko's or Reche's analytic estimates. title: The 2026 Reche exponent improves Soundararajan–Young, not the modular-group record
